SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
UNION
SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
LEFT JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.ANA > 0 
  AND (
    (L.DNA IS NOT NULL AND L.DNA != '-' AND L.DNA != 'None')
    OR (L.SM IS NOT NULL AND L.SM != '-' AND L.SM != 'None')
    OR (L.SSA IS NOT NULL AND L.SSA != '-' AND L.SSA != 'None')
    OR (L.RNP IS NOT NULL AND L.RNP != '-' AND L.RNP != 'None')
  );

WITH pat AS (
    SELECT
        E.ID,
        MAX(CASE WHEN E."ANA" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_ANA,
        MAX(CASE WHEN (L."DNA" IS NOT NULL AND L."DNA" > 0) OR (L."DNA-II" IS NOT NULL AND L."DNA-II" > 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_dsdna,
        MAX(CASE WHEN L."SM" = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_sm,
        MAX(CASE WHEN (E."aCL IgG" > 0) OR (E."aCL IgM" > 0) OR (E."aCL IgA" > 0) OR (E."LAC" = '+') OR (E."KCT" = '+') OR (E."RVVT" = '+') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_aphospholipid,
        MAX(CASE WHEN (L."C3" IS NOT NULL AND L."C3" <= 35) OR (L."C4" IS NOT NULL AND L."C4" <= 10) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_lowcomp
    FROM "Examination" E
    LEFT JOIN "Laboratory" L ON E.ID = L.ID
    GROUP BY E.ID
)
SELECT ID
FROM pat
WHERE has_ANA = 1
  AND ( (CASE WHEN has_dsdna THEN 6 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN has_sm THEN 6 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN has_aphospholipid THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN has_lowcomp THEN 3 ELSE 0 END) ) >= 10;
}

    SELECT l.ID, l."T-CHO"
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN (
        SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS max_date
        FROM Laboratory
        GROUP BY ID
    ) m ON l.ID = m.ID AND l.Date = m.max_date

patient_risk AS (
    SELECT
        p.ID,
        CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age,
        p.SEX,
        (
            CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.25 AS REAL) * 0.3
            + CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 5 ELSE 0 END
            + CASE WHEN l."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL AND l."T-CHO" >= 200 THEN 5 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS risk_percentage
    FROM Patient p
    LEFT JOIN latest_lab l ON p.ID = l.ID
)
SELECT ID, age, SEX, risk_percentage
FROM patient_risk
WHERE risk_percentage >= 20
ORDER BY risk_percentage DESC;

FraminghamScore AS (
    SELECT 
        pa.ID,
        pa.age,
        pa.SEX,
        mdl.T_CHO AS total_cholesterol,
        CASE 
            WHEN pa.age >= 60 AND mdl.T_CHO >= 240 AND pa.SEX = 'M' THEN 28.0
            WHEN pa.age >= 60 AND mdl.T_CHO >= 240 AND pa.SEX = 'F' THEN 26.0
            WHEN pa.age >= 50 AND mdl.T_CHO >= 240 AND pa.SEX = 'M' THEN 24.0
            WHEN pa.age >= 50 AND mdl.T_CHO >= 240 AND pa.SEX = 'F' THEN 22.0
            WHEN pa.age >= 60 AND mdl.T_CHO >= 200 AND pa.SEX = 'M' THEN 20.0
            WHEN pa.age >= 60 AND mdl.T_CHO >= 200 AND pa.SEX = 'F' THEN 20.0
            ELSE NULL
        END AS risk_percentage
    FROM PatientAge pa
    INNER JOIN MaxDateLab mdl ON pa.ID = mdl.ID

WITH latest_lab AS (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS max_date
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT l.ID,
       CASE
         WHEN (l.CRE IS NOT NULL AND l.CRE < 1.0)
              AND (l.UN IS NOT NULL AND l.UN < 20)
              AND (l."U-PRO" IS NULL OR (l."U-PRO" NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%' AND CAST(l."U-PRO" AS INTEGER) <= 30))
           THEN 'early-stage'
         WHEN (l.CRE IS NOT NULL AND l.CRE BETWEEN 1.0 AND 2.0)
              OR (l.UN IS NOT NULL AND l.UN BETWEEN 20 AND 30)
              OR (l."U-PRO" NOT NULL AND l."U-PRO" NOT LIKE '%[^0-9]%' AND CAST(l."U-PRO" AS INTEGER) > 30 AND CAST(l."U-PRO" AS INTEGER) <= 100)
           THEN 'active-phase'
         ELSE 'late-stage'
       END AS stage
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN latest_lab ll ON l.ID = ll.ID AND l.Date = ll.max_date
ORDER BY l.ID;

WITH LatestLab AS (
    SELECT 
        ID,
        Date,
        CRE,
        UN,
        `U-PRO`
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            ID,
            Date,
            CRE,
            UN,
            `U-PRO`,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
        FROM Laboratory
        WHERE CRE IS NOT NULL AND CAST(CRE AS REAL) > 0
    ) ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN CAST(CRE AS REAL) >= 3.0 THEN 'late-stage'
        WHEN CAST(CRE AS REAL) >= 1.5 THEN 'active-phase'
        ELSE 'early-stage'
    END AS ckd_stage
FROM LatestLab;

WITH
    ana AS (
        SELECT e.ID,
               MAX(e."Examination Date") AS latest_ana_date,
               MAX(CASE WHEN e.ANA > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_ana
        FROM Examination e
        WHERE e.ANA > 0
        GROUP BY e.ID
    ),
    antiphosp AS (
        SELECT e.ID,
               MAX(CASE WHEN e.KCT = '+' OR e.RVVT = '+' OR e.LAC = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_aph
        FROM Examination e
        GROUP BY e.ID
    ),
    lab AS (
        SELECT l.ID,
               MAX(CASE WHEN l.DNA = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_dna,
               MAX(CASE WHEN l.SM = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_sm,
               MAX(CASE WHEN l.C3 IS NOT NULL AND l.C3 < 35 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_c3,
               MAX(CASE WHEN l.C4 IS NOT NULL AND l.C4 < 10 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_c4
        FROM Laboratory l
        GROUP BY l.ID
    ),
    scores AS (
        SELECT p.ID,
               (COALESCE(ana.has_ana, 0) +
                COALESCE(antiphosp.has_aph, 0) +
                COALESCE(lab.has_dna, 0) +
                COALESCE(lab.has_sm, 0) +
                CASE WHEN COALESCE(lab.low_c3, 0) = 1 OR COALESCE(lab.low_c4, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score,
               ana.latest_ana_date
        FROM Patient p
        LEFT JOIN ana ON p.ID = ana.ID
        LEFT JOIN antiphosp ON p.ID = antiphosp.ID
        LEFT JOIN lab ON p.ID = lab.ID
    )
SELECT ID, total_score, latest_ana_date
FROM scores
WHERE total_score >= 4
ORDER BY ID;

WITH ANA_Positive_Tests AS (
    SELECT 
        e.ID,
        e.`Examination Date`,
        e.ANA,
        e.`ANA Pattern`
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.ANA IS NOT NULL AND e.ANA > 0 AND e.`ANA Pattern` != 'None'
),
Most_Recent_ANA AS (
    SELECT 
        ID,
        MAX(`Examination Date`) AS most_recent_ana_date
    FROM ANA_Positive_Tests
    GROUP BY ID
),
Criteria_Score AS (
    SELECT 
        p.ID AS patient_id,
        mra.most_recent_ana_date,
        (
            -- Entry Criterion: Positive ANA (10 points minimum to qualify)
            CASE WHEN mra.most_recent_ana_date IS NOT NULL THEN 10 ELSE 0 END +
            -- Immunologic Domain: Anti-phospholipid antibodies (aCL IgG, IgM elevated)
            CASE WHEN e.`aCL IgG` > 5 OR e.`aCL IgM` > 5 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
            -- Immunologic Domain: Anti-dsDNA/LAC positive
            CASE WHEN l.`DNA-II` > 8 OR l.LAC = '+' THEN 6 ELSE 0 END +
            -- Immunologic Domain: Complement low
            CASE WHEN l.C3 < 35 OR l.C4 < 10 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END +
            -- Clinical Domain: SLE Diagnosis noted
            CASE WHEN e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN 6 ELSE 0 END +
            -- Additional autoimmune markers
            CASE WHEN l.SSA = '+' OR l.SSB = '+' OR l.SM = '+' THEN 3 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS total_criteria_score
    FROM Patient p
    INNER JOIN Most_Recent_ANA mra ON p.ID = mra.ID
    LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
    LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
    GROUP BY p.ID, mra.most_recent_ana_date, e.`aCL IgG`, e.`aCL IgM`, e.Diagnosis, l.`DNA-II`, l.LAC, l.C3, l.C4, l.SSA, l.SSB, l.SM, p.Diagnosis
)
SELECT 
    patient_id,
    total_criteria_score,
    most_recent_ana_date
FROM Criteria_Score
WHERE total_criteria_score >= 10
ORDER BY patient_id;

WITH ana_pos AS (
    SELECT e.ID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN e."ANA" >= 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ana_pos_flag,
           MAX(CASE WHEN e."ANA" >= 80 THEN e."Examination Date" END) AS most_recent_ana_date
    FROM "Examination" e
    GROUP BY e.ID
),
labs AS (
    SELECT l.ID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN (l."DNA" = '+' OR l."DNA-II" >= 8) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS anti_dsDNA,
           MAX(CASE WHEN l."SM" = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS anti_SM,
           MAX(CASE WHEN (l."C3" <= 35 OR l."C4" <= 10) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS low_comp,
           MAX(CASE WHEN l."PLT" < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS thrombocytopenia,
           MAX(CASE WHEN l."WBC" < 3.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS leukopenia
    FROM "Laboratory" l
    GROUP BY l.ID
),
exam AS (
    SELECT e.ID,
           MAX(CASE WHEN e."aCL IgG" > 0 OR e."aCL IgM" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS aCL_pos,
           MAX(CASE WHEN e."KCT" = '+' OR e."RVVT" = '+' OR e."LAC" = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lac_pos,
           MAX(CASE WHEN e."Thrombosis" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS thrombosis_pos
    FROM "Examination" e
    GROUP BY e.ID
)
SELECT
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    (COALESCE(l.anti_dsDNA,0)*6 +
     COALESCE(l.anti_SM,0)*6 +
     (CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.aCL_pos,0)=1 OR COALESCE(e.lac_pos,0)=1 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
     COALESCE(l.low_comp,0)*4 +
     COALESCE(l.thrombocytopenia,0)*4 +
     COALESCE(l.leukopenia,0)*3 +
     COALESCE(e.thrombosis_pos,0)*4) AS total_score,
    a.most_recent_ana_date
FROM "Patient" p
JOIN ana_pos a ON p.ID = a.ID
JOIN labs l ON p.ID = l.ID
LEFT JOIN exam e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE a.ana_pos_flag = 1
  AND (COALESCE(l.anti_dsDNA,0)*6 +
       COALESCE(l.anti_SM,0)*6 +
       (CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.aCL_pos,0)=1 OR COALESCE(e.lac_pos,0)=1 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
       COALESCE(l.low_comp,0)*4 +
       COALESCE(l.thrombocytopenia,0)*4 +
       COALESCE(l.leukopenia,0)*3 +
       COALESCE(e.thrombosis_pos,0)*4) >= 10;

- Low C3 OR low C4: 4 points
- Low C3 AND low C4: 6 points

The query gives only 4 points regardless (using MAX with single conditions). ✗

**c) Assumed Thresholds Not Verifiable:**
- ANA >= 80 threshold assumed (schema doesn't specify units)
- C3 <= 35, C4 <= 10 assumed (no clinical reference range in schema)
- DNA-II >= 8 contradicts schema comment (Normal range N < 8)

Query checks `l."DNA" = '+'` but schema defines DNA as TEXT with no indication it stores '+'/'-' values like KCT/RVVT/LAC do.

The scoring weights (6, 4, 3, 2 points) and the >=10 threshold are hardcoded constants not derivable from the database or provided evidence.

The question specifically asks for "2019 ACR/EULAR classification criteria" which requires:

## Analysis Steps

### 1. Understanding the Sydney Criteria
The Sydney (revised Sapporo) criteria for APS requires:
- **Clinical criterion**: Vascular thrombosis OR pregnancy morbidity
- **Laboratory criterion**: Lupus anticoagulant (LA), anticardiolipin antibodies (aCL IgG/IgM), or anti-β2GP-I antibodies
- **Both must be present**, with confirmation on **two or more occasions at least 12 weeks apart**

### 2. Issues with the Query

**Coagulation Tests Counted Separately:** LAC, KCT, and RVVT are all different methods to detect lupus anticoagulant. Treating them as three separate criteria incorrectly multiplies the weight of one criterion type.

**Missing Multiple Occasions Requirement:** The Sydney criteria requires positive results on TWO OR MORE occasions at least 12 weeks apart. This query analyzes individual examinations without verifying this longitudinal requirement.

### 3. Database Context
While the database contains examination records that could potentially show multiple visits, the query structure doesn't check for temporal separation or confirm repeated positive findings as required by Sydney criteria.

ORDER BY criteria_count DESC;

WITH LatestLab AS (
    SELECT 
        l.ID,
        l."T-BIL",
        l.PT,
        l.CRE
    FROM Laboratory l
    INNER JOIN (
        SELECT ID, MAX(Date) as max_date
        FROM Laboratory
        WHERE Date != '0000-00-00'
        GROUP BY ID
    ) latest ON l.ID = latest.ID AND l.Date = latest.max_date
    WHERE l."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL 
        AND l."T-BIL" > 0
        AND l.PT IS NOT NULL
        AND l.PT > 0
        AND l.CRE IS NOT NULL
        AND l.CRE > 0
)
SELECT 
    ID,
    ROUND(3.78 * log("T-BIL") + 11.2 * log(PT) + 9.57 * log(CRE) + 6.43, 1) AS meld_score
FROM LatestLab
ORDER BY meld_score DESC;

WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        ID,
        "T-BIL" AS bilirubin,
        PT AS inr,
        CRE AS creatinine,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT
    ID,
    (3.78 * LOG(CASE WHEN bilirubin < 1 THEN 1 ELSE bilirubin END) +
     11.2 * LOG(CASE WHEN inr < 1 THEN 1 ELSE inr END) +
     9.57 * LOG(CASE WHEN creatinine < 1 THEN 1 ELSE creatinine END) +
     6.43) AS MELD
FROM latest
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY MELD DESC;

## Step-by-Step Evaluation

### 1. Schema Verification
The query reads from the `Laboratory` table, which exists in the schema. It uses columns `ID`, `Date`, `T-BIL`, `PT`, and `CRE`, which all exist in the Laboratory table.

- Return patient IDs ranked by MELD score

**What the query does:**
- ✓ Identifies most recent lab test per patient using ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC)
- ✓ Uses the correct MELD formula structure with 3.78×ln(bilirubin) + 11.2×ln(INR) + 9.57×ln(creatinine) + 6.43
- ✓ Includes the minimum value clamping (CASE WHEN < 1 THEN 1)
- ✓ Returns ID and MELD score ordered by MELD DESC

### 3. Critical Issue Found

**The MELD score requires INR (International Normalized Ratio), but the query uses PT (Prothrombin Time).**

According to the schema:
- `PT` is stored in the Laboratory table (prothrombin time in seconds)
- There is **no INR column** in any table

PT and INR are different measurements:
- PT is measured in seconds (~11-13.5 normally)
- INR is a standardized ratio derived from PT

The query incorrectly treats PT values as if they were INR values. This is a fundamental calculation error because:
- INR values are typically around 1.0-2.0 (can go higher)
- PT values are typically around 11-14 seconds

Using PT directly instead of INR will produce **completely incorrect MELD scores**, making the prioritization results meaningless.

### 4. Decision

Per the validation guidelines: *"Rejecting such a query is better than accepting an answer that does not match what the user asked for, even when it is the best query that the schema allows."*

The query depends on substituting PT for INR—a value/definition not in the database. Even though this may be the best approximation possible given the schema, it does not correctly answer the question as asked because MELD scores cannot be accurately calculated without proper INR values.

    JOIN (
        SELECT ID, MAX("Examination Date") AS max_date
        FROM Examination
        GROUP BY ID
    ) me ON e.ID = me.ID AND e."Examination Date" = me.max_date
)

       (CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +

       COALESCE(l.RBC, 0) +
       COALESCE(e.ANA, 0) +

FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN latest_lab l   ON p.ID = l.ID
LEFT JOIN latest_exam e  ON p.ID = e.ID
ORDER BY "Chronic Care Progression Score" DESC;

WITH latest_exam AS (
    SELECT e.ID,
           e."aCL IgG",
           e."aCL IgM",
           e."aCL IgA",
           e.ANA,
           e."KCT",
           e.RVVT,
           e.LAC,
           e.Thrombosis,
           e.Symptoms
    FROM Examination e
    JOIN (
        SELECT ID, MAX("Examination Date") AS max_date
        FROM Examination
        GROUP BY ID
    ) me ON e.ID = me.ID AND e."Examination Date" = me.max_date
),
latest_lab AS (
    SELECT l.ID,
           l.C3,
           l.C4,
           l.DNA,
           l."DNA-II",
           l.CRP
    FROM Laboratory l
    JOIN (
        SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS max_date
        FROM Laboratory
        GROUP BY ID
    ) ml ON l.ID = ml.ID AND l.Date = ml.max_date
)
SELECT p.ID
FROM Patient p
JOIN latest_exam e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN latest_lab l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE (
    (CASE WHEN e.ANA > 0 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN e."aCL IgG" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN e."aCL IgM" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN e."aCL IgA" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN e."KCT" = '+' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN e.RVVT = '+' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN e.LAC = '+' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN e.Thrombosis > 0 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN l.C3 IS NOT NULL AND l.C3 < 35 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN l.C4 IS NOT NULL AND l.C4 < 10 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN l.DNA IS NOT NULL AND l.DNA <> '-' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN l."DNA-II" IS NOT NULL AND l."DNA-II" > 0 THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN l.CRP IS NOT NULL AND l.CRP <> '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN e.Symptoms LIKE '%rash%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN e.Symptoms LIKE '%arthritis%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN e.Symptoms LIKE '%serositis%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
    (CASE WHEN e.Symptoms LIKE '%nephritis%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)
) > 10;

WITH RecentLabData AS (
    SELECT 
        ID,
        PLT,
        WBC,
        HGB,
        `U-PRO`,
        C3,
        C4,
        `DNA-II`,
        Date,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) as rn
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE Date != '0000-00-00'
),
SLEDAICalculation AS (
    SELECT 
        p.ID,
        (
            -- Hematological: Thrombocytopenia (<100K)
            CASE WHEN r.PLT < 100 THEN 4 ELSE 0 END +
            -- Hematological: Leukopenia (<4.0K)
            CASE WHEN r.WBC < 4.0 THEN 4 ELSE 0 END +
            -- Hematological: Anemia (HGB < 10)
            CASE WHEN r.HGB < 10 THEN 4 ELSE 0 END +
            -- Renal: Proteinuria (positive)
            CASE WHEN r.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL AND r.`U-PRO` != 'None' AND r.`U-PRO` != '' AND r.`U-PRO` != '0' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END +
            -- Immunological: Low Complement C3 (<35) or C4 (<10)
            CASE WHEN (r.C3 < 35 OR r.C4 < 10) THEN 4 ELSE 0 END +
            -- Immunological: Elevated anti-DNA (>8)
            CASE WHEN r.`DNA-II` > 8 THEN 6 ELSE 0 END +
            -- Constitutional: Check for fever/fatigue in symptoms
            CASE WHEN e.Symptoms LIKE '%fever%' OR e.Symptoms LIKE '%fatigue%' OR e.Symptoms LIKE '%malaise%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
            -- Musculoskeletal: Check for arthritis/joint pain
            CASE WHEN e.Symptoms LIKE '%arthrit%' OR e.Symptoms LIKE '%joint%' OR e.Symptoms LIKE '%pain%' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END +
            -- Serositis: Check for pleuritic/pericardial chest pain
            CASE WHEN e.Symptoms LIKE '%pleuri%' OR e.Symptoms LIKE '%pericar%' OR e.Symptoms LIKE '%chest%' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END +
            -- Neuropsychiatric: Check for seizure/confusion/psychosis
            CASE WHEN e.Symptoms LIKE '%seizure%' OR e.Symptoms LIKE '%confus%' OR e.Symptoms LIKE '%psychos%' OR e.Symptoms LIKE '%headach%' THEN 8 ELSE 0 END +
            -- Vascular/Vasculitis
            CASE WHEN e.Symptoms LIKE '%vasculit%' OR e.Symptoms LIKE '%ulcer%' OR e.Symptoms LIKE '%rash%' THEN 4 ELSE 0 END
        ) AS SLEDAI_Score
    FROM Patient p
    LEFT JOIN RecentLabData r ON p.ID = r.ID AND r.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
)
SELECT ID FROM SLEDAICalculation WHERE SLEDAI_Score > 10;

SELECT patient_id, total_score FROM (
    SELECT p.ID AS patient_id,
           (
               (CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM Examination e
                        WHERE e.ID = p.ID
                          AND e."aCL IgG" IS NOT NULL
                          AND e."aCL IgG" > 0)
                THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
               (CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM Examination e
                        WHERE e.ID = p.ID
                          AND e."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL
                          AND e."aCL IgM" > 0)
                THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
               (CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM Examination e
                        WHERE e.ID = p.ID
                          AND e.LAC = '+')
                THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) +
               (CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l
                        WHERE l.ID = p.ID
                          AND l.C3 IS NOT NULL
                          AND l.C3 < 35)
                THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) +
               (CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l
                        WHERE l.ID = p.ID
                          AND l.C4 IS NOT NULL
                          AND l.C4 < 10)
                THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) +
               (CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l
                        WHERE l.ID = p.ID
                          AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
                          AND l.DNA <> ''
                          AND l.DNA <> '-')
                THEN 6 ELSE 0 END) +
               (CASE WHEN EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory l
                        WHERE l.ID = p.ID
                          AND l.SM IS NOT NULL
                          AND l.SM <> ''
                          AND l.SM <> '-')
                THEN 6 ELSE 0 END)
           ) AS total_score
    FROM Patient p
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM Examination e
        WHERE e.ID = p.ID
          AND e.ANA IS NOT NULL
          AND e.ANA > 0)
) sub
WHERE total_score >= 10;

### 2. Question Requirements
The question asks specifically about the **"2022 ACR/EULAR classification criteria"** for Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE). These criteria have specific requirements:

**Entry Criterion**: ANA ≥1:80 (equivalent)

**Weighted Scoring Domains** include:
- Immunological domains: Antiphospholipid antibodies (up to 6 pts), Complement deficiency (up to 6 pts), Anti-dsDNA/Smith (up to 6 pts)
- Clinical domains: Constitutional, Hematologic, Neuropsychiatric, Mucocutaneous, Musculoskeletal, Renal (various point values)

**Classification Rule**: Total score ≥10 AND at least one clinical criterion must be met

### 3. Query Analysis Issues

**Critical Problems Identified:**

1. **Missing Clinical Criteria**: The 2022 ACR/EULAR criteria require clinical manifestations (fever, arthritis, rash, renal disease, neurologic symptoms, etc.). The database schema does NOT contain columns for these clinical symptoms - only laboratory/examination data exists. This makes proper classification impossible.

2. **Score Calculation Errors**: 
   - Antiphospholipid antibodies (aPL) in 2022 criteria are scored as ONE domain (max 6 points), not separately for each type (aCL IgG + aCL IgM + LAC = 6 points max, not 2+2+2=6 points separately counted)
   - The query adds all three aPL tests independently which violates the "domain" concept
   - Complements (C3, C4) should share a domain score, not stack

3. **Missing Entry Criterion Validation**: While ANA check exists, the actual threshold (≥1:80 titer) isn't verified - it just checks ANA IS NOT NULL AND > 0

4. **Hardcoded Thresholds Without Evidence**: The query uses constants (C3 < 35, C4 < 10) without these thresholds being documented in the schema or question evidence

5. **No Clinical Domain Requirement**: The query doesn't verify that clinical criteria are met, which is required by the 2022 ACR/EULAR criteria for classification

This query fails because:
- The database schema lacks clinical symptom data required by the 2022 ACR/EULAR criteria
- The scoring calculation doesn't follow the actual 2022 ACR/EULAR domain-based scoring rules
- It assumes classification can be done without clinical criteria, which contradicts the official criteria

WITH SLE_Patients AS (
    SELECT 
        P.ID,
        E.Examination_Date,
        E.ANA,
        E.aCL_IgG,
        E.aCL_IgM,
        E.aCL_IgA,
        E.Diagnosis,
        E.KCT,
        E.RVVT,
        E.LAC,
        E.Symptoms,
        E.Thrombosis
    FROM Patient P
    INNER JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
    WHERE E.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
),
Lab_Data AS (
    SELECT 
        ID,
        Date,
        DNA,
        `DNA-II`,
        C3,
        C4,
        SM,
        CRP
    FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT 
    S.ID,
    ROUND(
        (CASE WHEN S.ANA > 0 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN COALESCE(S.aCL_IgG, 0) > 1.0 OR COALESCE(S.aCL_IgM, 0) > 1.0 THEN 6 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN S.aCL_IgA > 0 THEN 6 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN (S.KCT = '+' OR S.RVVT = '+' OR S.LAC = '+') THEN 6 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN S.Thrombosis > 0 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) +
        (CASE WHEN S.Symptoms IS NOT NULL AND S.Symptoms != 'None' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)
    , 2) AS total_classification_score
FROM SLE_Patients S
GROUP BY S.ID
HAVING (CASE WHEN S.ANA > 0 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) +
       (CASE WHEN COALESCE(S.aCL_IgG, 0) > 1.0 OR COALESCE(S.aCL_IgM, 0) > 1.0 THEN 6 ELSE 0 END) +
       (CASE WHEN S.aCL_IgA > 0 THEN 6 ELSE 0 END) +
       (CASE WHEN (S.KCT = '+' OR S.RVVT = '+' OR S.LAC = '+') THEN 6 ELSE 0 END) +
       (CASE WHEN S.Thrombosis > 0 THEN 10 ELSE 0 END) +
       (CASE WHEN S.Symptoms IS NOT NULL AND S.Symptoms != 'None' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) >= 10
ORDER BY S.ID;

WITH latest_exam AS (
    SELECT e.ID,
           e.ANA,
           e."aCL IgG",
           e."aCL IgM",
           e."aCL IgA",
           e.KCT,
           e.RVVT,
           e.LAC
    FROM "Examination" e
    JOIN (
        SELECT ID, MAX("Examination Date") AS max_date
        FROM "Examination"
        GROUP BY ID
    ) e2 ON e.ID = e2.ID AND e."Examination Date" = e2.max_date
),
latest_lab AS (
    SELECT l.ID,
           l.DNA,
           l.SM,
           l.C3,
           l.C4
    FROM "Laboratory" l
    JOIN (
        SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS max_date
        FROM "Laboratory"
        GROUP BY ID
    ) l2 ON l.ID = l2.ID AND l.Date = l2.max_date
)
SELECT p.ID AS patient_id,
       (CASE WHEN ll.DNA IN ('+-', '+') THEN 6 ELSE 0 END) +
       (CASE WHEN ll.SM IN ('+-', '+') THEN 6 ELSE 0 END) +
       (CASE WHEN (le."aCL IgG" > 40 OR le."aCL IgM" > 40 OR le."aCL IgA" > 40 OR le.KCT = '+' OR le.RVVT = '+' OR le.LAC = '+') THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) +
       (CASE WHEN (ll.C3 <= 35 OR ll.C4 <= 10) THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) AS total_classification_score
FROM "Patient" p
LEFT JOIN latest_exam le ON p.ID = le.ID
LEFT JOIN latest_lab ll ON p.ID = ll.ID
WHERE le.ANA > 0
  AND (CASE WHEN ll.DNA IN ('+-', '+') THEN 6 ELSE 0 END +
       CASE WHEN ll.SM IN ('+-', '+') THEN 6 ELSE 0 END +
       CASE WHEN (le."aCL IgG" > 40 OR le."aCL IgM" > 40 OR le."aCL IgA" > 40 OR le.KCT = '+' OR le.RVVT = '+' OR le.LAC = '+') THEN 4 ELSE 0 END +
       CASE WHEN (ll.C3 <= 35 OR ll.C4 <= 10) THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) >= 10;

WITH latest_exam AS (
    SELECT e.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.ID ORDER BY e."Examination Date" DESC) AS rn
    FROM Examination e
)
SELECT le.ID,
       (CASE WHEN le."aCL IgG" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN le."aCL IgM" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        COALESCE(le."aCL IgA", 0) +
        CASE WHEN le.KCT = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN le.RVVT = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN le.LAC = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
        CASE WHEN le.Thrombosis > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_score
FROM latest_exam le
WHERE le.rn = 1
  AND (CASE WHEN le."aCL IgG" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
       CASE WHEN le."aCL IgM" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
       COALESCE(le."aCL IgA", 0) +
       CASE WHEN le.KCT = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
       CASE WHEN le.RVVT = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +

WITH latest_exam AS (
    SELECT e.ID,
           e."Examination Date",
           e."aCL IgG",
           e."aCL IgM",
           e."aCL IgA",
           e.KCT,
           e.RVVT,
           e.LAC,
           e.Thrombosis
    FROM "Examination" e
    JOIN (
        SELECT ID, MAX("Examination Date") AS max_date
        FROM "Examination"
        GROUP BY ID
    ) m ON e.ID = m.ID AND e."Examination Date" = m.max_date
),
scored AS (
    SELECT ID,
           (CASE WHEN "aCL IgG" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
           (CASE WHEN "aCL IgM" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
           (CASE WHEN "aCL IgA" > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
           (CASE WHEN KCT = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
           (CASE WHEN RVVT = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) +
           (CASE WHEN LAC = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lab_pos,
           Thrombosis
    FROM latest_exam
)
SELECT s.ID AS patient_id,
       (s.lab_pos + s.Thrombosis) AS total_risk_score
FROM scored s
WHERE s.Thrombosis > 0
  AND s.lab_pos >= 2
ORDER BY s.ID;
